title: Rayagada Nirbandha & Engagement Vision
subtitle: 11th February 2027 • Kalyan Mandap / Convention Center • 300–450 Guests
contentHtml:
🌸

1. Sacred Vedic Aesthetic

Imperial Gold, Sacred Marigold, and Ivory Jasmine palette honoring traditional Odia Nirbandha customs.

👑

2. Turnkey Indoor Setup

Elevated 30ft × 18ft stage with 8ft floral ring, Maharaja sofa, and dedicated Purohit Patra Paribartana chowki.

⚡

3. Zero-Blackout Safety

Dedicated 40 kVA AMF DG generator backup ensuring flawless lighting, sound, and photography throughout.

title: Swagata Torana & Vilakku Central Aisle
subtitle: Sacred Odia Temple Corridor & Dignified Banquet Seating
contentHtml:
Grand Swagata Torana Entrance

12ft × 14ft solid truss arched gateway lined with 100% fresh marigold garlands, hanging jasmine strings, and antique brass Purna Kumbha water urns on carved wooden plinths.

Brass Vilakku Central Aisle

6ft wide carpeted ceremonial walkway illuminated by tall polished brass Vilakku oil lamps on brass stands leading directly to the centerstage.

title: Nirbandha Centerstage & Floral Ring Halo
subtitle: 30ft × 18ft Elevated Stage • 8ft Circular Floral Ring • 3D Backlit Gold Monogram
contentHtml:
Ring Exchange Stage Architecture

30ft × 18ft stage at 2.5ft elevation with 18mm marine plywood deck. Features 8ft circular floral ring packed with fresh marigold and white tuberoses, royal ivory silk back drapes, and Maharaja velvet sofa.

Sacred Patra Paribartana Chowki

Dedicated 8x8ft Vedic ritual zone on stage left with low carved wooden Pidha, embroidered red velvet aasan, silver puja thali, brass deepams, and traditional coconuts/Gua betel nuts.

title: Photo-Op Memory Wall & Odia Feast Styling
subtitle: 10ft × 8ft Foliage Backdrop • Studio Softbox Keylights • Clean Buffet Pass
contentHtml:
Botanical Foliage Memory Wall

10ft × 8ft non-glare botanical wall with hanging brass bells and warm neon calligraphy: 'Forever Begins Today — Sree & Krushna', illuminated by twin 45° studio softbox portrait lights.

Dining Pavilion & Handwash Hygiene

4 parallel buffet lines with chafing sneeze guards, fresh table centerpieces, and slip-proof dry matting at handwash basins.

title: Commercial Budget & Operational Gates
subtitle: Turnkey Package Settlement • T-3 Hour Completion Gate • Zero Hidden Charges
contentHtml:
Turnkey Budget Target (₹40,000–₹55,000)

Comprehensive all-inclusive pricing covering Swagata Torana, 30x18ft Stage, Floral Ring Halo, 3D Monogram, Photo Wall, 300 Chair Covers, Sound PA, and 40 kVA DG backup.

Operational Handover Gate

100% decor setup complete by 07:00 AM (T-3 hours before guest arrival). Complete power load test conducted on DG before ceremony start.
